generation_review.prompt:
Draw exactly ONE new Small Seal font glyph from the attached reference image. It shows FOUR historical specimen slots of the SAME character labelled THX, CCZ, QJZ and DYC; any slot marked UNAVAILABLE is absent evidence. Study ALL AVAILABLE specimens equally. Reconstruct one coherent attested whole form with the original ancient identity; do not combine incompatible variant components, imitate only THX, or substitute a modern Chinese character.

Build genuine smooth stroke trajectories as original harmonious Gothic monoline drawing, with absolutely CONSTANT stroke width around 3% of the full canvas. All strokes must share that width, with round caps and round joins, smooth rounded curves and precise straight bars, no taper, swelling, brush outlines, serifs, pressure modulation, textures or blobs. Keep every required counter and gap clearly open. Essential bar length relationships, branches, descending legs, tiny detached marks and contacts are structural requirements, not decoration.

Use a square 1:1 canvas. Center the ONE glyph inside the central70% with generous clear margins. Output ONLY pure BLACK constant-width strokes on a fully TRANSPARENT background, with no labels, text, codepoint, chart, grid, background, frame, shadows, watermark or multiple specimens. Exactly one complete glyph.

Explicit structural/proportion reading aid, coherent THX-type courses after all-four comparison:
U+3D07D. LEFT is a three-bar vertical stem; bar widths100(top),95(middle),115(bottom). RIGHT is one tall ancient composite. TOP a THREE-PRONG upward trident, central prong a little taller, joined by rounded upward-open bowl; its central stem descends to TOP vertex of a diamond/lozenge. In coherent THX form, lower center stem enters lozenge BOTTOM vertex and has a short FREE UPWARD TIP inside, leaving gap under top vertex so lozenge retains ONE connected white field. Beneath lozenge the lower center stem meets two outward curved/sloping shoulders. On left a short outer curved vertical continues downward; THREE horizontal bars run rightward from that left vertical THROUGH center stem, ending freely at right. Bar widths100,100,110 from top to bottom: lowest LONGEST. Upper arched shoulder space makes one triangular counter; between three bars are TWO stacked left counters, so this lattice has THREE small left fields total. Left lattice outside stem ENDS just below lowest bar, leaving clear gap before lower outside arch begins. CENTER stem continues down without a gap to the apex of a broad lower inverted-U arch. A short center stem within that lower arch forks diagonally DOWN-LEFT and DOWN-RIGHT, with BOTH diagonal ends JOINING arch sides to form TWO closed shoulder pockets. Arch has TWO long outer legs and OPEN bottom. Inside lower arch sits one separate HORIZONTAL OVAL/RING with ONE closed counter, detached from fork and legs. Preserve trident3prongs, lozengefree-tip, lattice3bars/3fields, lowerarch2shoulderpockets+1inneroval. No extra enclosure dividers, no prongs on inner oval.
